raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On CC 10.7 devices, `flashmla_ops` runs the `sm_100f` family binary. Native `sm_107a` codegen is faster for the FlashMLA kernels DeepSeek-V4.1 uses (fused `core_attn` decode/prefill), measured with per-kernel profiles of a serving run. Numbers are available on request.

The pinned CUTLASS (147f567) lists no SM107, so an `sm_107a` build compiles but silently loses features. This happens in three headers:

- `arch/config.h`: the SM100A/F MMA and TMA enables
- `arch/reg_reconfig.h`: `CUDA_CTA_RECONFIG_ACTIVATED`, so `warpgroup_reg_alloc/dealloc` (`setmaxnreg`) become no-ops and the warp-specialized kernels spill
- `arch/grid_dependency_control.h`: `CUTLASS_GDC_ENABLED` (PDL)

## Modifications

- `cmake/flashmla.cmake`: when `nvcc --list-gpu-arch` reports `compute_107`, add `-gencode=arch=compute_107a,code=sm_107a` and patch the fetched CUTLASS headers. This is the same approach as the existing SM103 `config.h` patch.
- `cmake/patch_cutlass_sm107.py`: an idempotent patch of the three headers. Each anchor must match exactly once.

Builds with an nvcc that lacks `compute_107` are unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

On a CC 10.7 device, with `flashmla_ops` built from this branch's cmake:
- The binary contains `sm_100`, `sm_103a` and `sm_107a` code.
- The `sm_107a` SASS has the same 254 `USETMAXREG` as the `sm_100f` build, and `core_attn` no longer spills.
- `tests/test_flashmla.py` and `tests/test_flashmla_mega.py`: 28 passed.
- DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash served end to end (TP4/EP4, DSpark) without errors.

A model-level accuracy eval is still to do (draft).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Per-kernel A/B against the `sm_100f` binary on the same device, ABBA-ordered serving profiles: fused `core_attn` decode and prefill are faster. The other FlashMLA kernels are neutral. The end-to-end difference at bs32 128K/1K is within run-to-run noise.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

Related: the same CUTLASS patch for the DeepGEMM and FlashMLA forks (links below).

nodes.body: Related: sgl-project/sglang#45884 (sglang `flashmla_ops` build), sgl-project/DeepGEMM#113 (DeepGEMM JIT), sgl-project/FlashMLA#20 (FlashMLA wheel). All three use the same CUTLASS SM107 patch.

Status update: this PR is on hold, and its current branch does not build.

- Moving FlashMLA's CUTLASS from the 147f567 pin to v4.8.1 (the first release with native SM107 support) needs FlashMLA source changes. FlashMLA@3620b63, which sgl-kernel builds today, does not compile against it: `TMEM::MAX_CAPACITY_BITS` is gone, and the F8F6F4 UMMA op is now a template. Those fixes belong in FlashMLA, not here.
- The DSv4.1 FlashMLA kernels are moving to the `sgl-flash-mla` wheel (#45635, built by #45651's workflow). sgl-project/FlashMLA#20 bumps the fork's CUTLASS to v4.8.1 with the source fixes and adds `sm_107a` when nvcc lists compute_107. The CUDA 13.4 release build then picks that up as is.

Plan: once FlashMLA#20 lands in a released `sgl-flash-mla` and #45635 merges, I'll repurpose this PR to bump the `sgl-flash-mla` pin. I'll drop the in-tree CUTLASS change unless the remaining sgl-kernel FlashMLA paths need it.

Closing: this is superseded.

- #45893 moved every CUDA FlashMLA call to the `sgl-flash-mla` wheel (via `sglang.kernels.ops.attention.flash_mla_interface`), so sgl-kernel's `flashmla_ops` is no longer used on CUDA.
- #45908 removes FlashMLA from the sgl-kernel build, including `cmake/flashmla.cmake`, the file this PR changes.
- The wheel already builds sm_107a: sgl-project/FlashMLA#20 adds `sm_107a` when nvcc reports `compute_107` and moves to CUTLASS 4.8.1, so the header patch isn't needed. The published `sgl-flash-mla==1.0.0` wheels (x86_64 and aarch64) carry native sm_107 SASS in both `cuda.abi3.so` and `_C_legacy.abi3.so`.

files.patch:
@@ -7,11 +7,11 @@ FetchContent_Declare(
 )
 FetchContent_Populate(repo-flashmla)
 
-# flashmla submodule pin: NVIDIA/cutlass @ 147f5673d0c1c3dcf66f78d677fd647e4a020219
+# NVIDIA/cutlass v4.8.1, ahead of the flashmla submodule pin
 FetchContent_Declare(
     repo-flashmla-cutlass
-    URL      https://${GITHUB_ARTIFACTORY}/NVIDIA/cutlass/archive/147f5673d0c1c3dcf66f78d677fd647e4a020219.tar.gz
-    URL_HASH SHA256=9f6c53320a85b4a570975e557918cde65168cd311f081920446c238437347dc6
+    URL      https://${GITHUB_ARTIFACTORY}/NVIDIA/cutlass/archive/2c85f497547eb441f0fe80bfb0fb2e6f9add1719.tar.gz
+    URL_HASH SHA256=bc246a2e5eb99be6e9f8cf30ee17f83af7ede97caa39cb7e8a6c7f8ca54a1583
     SOURCE_DIR ${repo-flashmla_SOURCE_DIR}/csrc/cutlass
 )
 FetchContent_Populate(repo-flashmla-cutlass)
@@ -44,45 +44,17 @@ endif()
 if(${CUDA_VERSION} VERSION_GREATER_EQUAL "13.0")
     # B300 is sm_103; sm_100f is family-compatible so it runs there, but ptxas emits
     # better SASS for the native arch. FlashMLA's setup.py picks sm_100a + sm_103a
-    # over sm_100f for the same reason. The cutlass patch below is what lets a TU
-    # compile at __CUDA_ARCH__ == 1030 against the pinned cutlass.
+    # over sm_100f for the same reason.
     list(APPEND FLASHMLA_CUDA_FLAGS
         "-gencode=arch=compute_103a,code=sm_103a"
     )
+endif()
 
-    # Patch cutlass/arch/config.h: add SM103 architecture defines.
-    # This patch is only needed (and only valid) with CUDA 13+.
-    # The new block is inserted right before the existing "// SM101 and SM101a"
-    # anchor in the upstream header.
-    set(CUTLASS_CONFIG_FILE "${repo-flashmla_SOURCE_DIR}/csrc/cutlass/include/cutlass/arch/config.h")
-    file(READ "${CUTLASS_CONFIG_FILE}" CUTLASS_CONFIG_CONTENT)
-    string(FIND "${CUTLASS_CONFIG_CONTENT}" "SM103" SM103_FOUND)
-    if(SM103_FOUND EQUAL -1)
-        string(REPLACE
-"// SM101 and SM101a"
-"// SM103 and SM103a
-#if !CUTLASS_CLANG_CUDA && (__CUDACC_VER_MAJOR__ >= 13)
-  #define CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM103_SUPPORTED 1
-  #if (!defined(CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM103_ENABLED) && defined(__CUDA_ARCH__) && __CUDA_ARCH__ == 1030)
-    #define CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM103_ENABLED 1
-    #if !defined(CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM100A_ENABLED)
-      #define CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM100A_ENABLED 1
-    #endif
-    #if !defined(CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM100F_ENABLED)
-      #define CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM100F_ENABLED 1
-    #endif
-  #endif
-#endif
-
-/////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
-
-// SM101 and SM101a"
-            CUTLASS_CONFIG_CONTENT "${CUTLASS_CONFIG_CONTENT}")
-        file(WRITE "${CUTLASS_CONFIG_FILE}" "${CUTLASS_CONFIG_CONTENT}")
-        message(STATUS "Patched cutlass/arch/config.h for SM103a support")
-    else()
-        message(STATUS "cutlass/arch/config.h already patched for SM103a")
-    endif()
+execute_process(COMMAND ${CMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER} --list-gpu-arch OUTPUT_VARIABLE FLASHMLA_NVCC_ARCHS ERROR_QUIET)
+if(FLASHMLA_NVCC_ARCHS MATCHES "compute_107")
+    list(APPEND FLASHMLA_CUDA_FLAGS
+        "-gencode=arch=compute_107a,code=sm_107a"
+    )
 endif()
